root=Path('/tmp/hipengine-gguf-mtp-current-20261024')
source=json.loads((root/'public-eos.json').read_text())
case=next(x for x in source['rows'] if x['prompt_id']=='code_merge_intervals')
p=SamplingParams(max_tokens=128,temperature=0.0,top_p=1.0,ignore_eos=False)
r={'schema':1,'kind':'gguf_mtp_ar_handoff_focused_repeat','performance_claim':False,'prompt_id':case['prompt_id'],'prompt':case['prompt'],'protocol':'one prompt, four in-load AR/MTP pairs, natural EOS, greedy D128; diagnostic only','rows':[]}
llm=LLM('/models/gguf/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf',backend='hip_gfx1100',execution_profile='production',max_active_requests=1,max_sequence_length=2048)

from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys
stream_only='--stream-only' in sys.argv
from hipengine import LLM,SamplingParams
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
from hipengine.benchmark.provenance import collect_artifact_provenance
from scripts.gguf_mtp_category_bench import load_prompt_rows
from scripts.specdec2_perf_gfx1100_child import _run_loaded_arm,_latest_route_metadata
root=Path('/tmp/hipengine-gguf-mtp-current-20261024')
old=json.loads(Path('/tmp/hipengine-paro-refresh-20261023/public-api.json').read_text())
expected={(r['prompt_id'],r['arm']):r['generated_token_ids'] for r in old['rows']}
cases=load_prompt_rows(Path('benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl'))
model='/models/hipengine/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-PARO-packed-MTP-BF16'
tokenizer=Tokenizer.from_file(str(Path(model)/'tokenizer.json'))
r={'schema':1,'kind':'paro_public_accounting_publication_validation','performance_claim':False,'baseline_commit':old['provenance']['commit'],'baseline_artifact':'benchmarks/results/2026-10-23-w7900-paro-mtp-refresh.json','rows':[],'streams':[]}
r['provenance']=collect_artifact_provenance(repo_root=Path.cwd(),configured_backend='hip_gfx1100',resolved_backend='hip_gfx1100',target_arch='gfx1100',model_path=model,quant='w4_paro',kv_dtype='bf16',command=[sys.executable,*sys.argv],timing_protocol='non-performance token/telemetry check',warmups=0,repetitions=1)
if stream_only:
 r=json.loads((root/'paro-publication.json').read_text())
 r['streams']=[]
 r.setdefault('blocking_source_hashes',r['source_hashes'])
 r['stream_validation_repair']='Preserve completed blocking checks; streams need not carry generated_token_ids. Verify rendered text and token counts instead.'
r['source_hashes']={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in map(Path,['hipengine/generation/engine_loop.py','hipengine/generation/qwen35_paro.py','hipengine/generation/qwen35_paro_mtp2.py'])}
def save(): (root/'paro-publication.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
llm=LLM(model,backend='hip_gfx1100',execution_profile='production',max_active_requests=1,max_sequence_length=1024)
try:
 llm.prepare(max_sequence_length=1024)
 for case in ([] if stream_only else cases):
  for arm in ('true_ar','staged'):
   value,wall,obs,route,_=_run_loaded_arm(llm,arm=arm,prompt=case['prompt'],max_tokens=25)
   ids=list(value.generated_token_ids); assert ids==expected[(case['id'],arm)],(case['id'],arm,'changed IDs')
   block=(value.telemetry.diagnostics or {}).get('specdec2_mtp2')
   if arm=='staged':
    assert block and route['specdec2_mtp2_used']
    assert block['mtp_output_tokens']+block['ar_output_tokens_in_cycles']==len(ids),(case['id'],block)
    assert block['mtp_output_tokens']==block['accepted_draft_tokens']+block['cycles']
   else: assert block is None
   r['rows'].append({'id':case['id'],'arm':arm,'ids':ids,'ids_unchanged':True,'accounting':block});save()
   print(case['id'],arm,'IDs unchanged and publication accounting exact',flush=True)
 for n in (2,24,25):
  for arm in ('true_ar','staged'):
   params=SamplingParams(max_tokens=n,temperature=0.0,top_p=1.0,ignore_eos=True)
   fn=llm.stream_detailed if arm=='true_ar' else llm.stream_speculative_mtp_detailed
   chunks=list(fn(cases[0]['prompt'],params)); assert chunks
   blocks=[]
   for chunk in chunks:
    if chunk.telemetry is None: continue
    b=(chunk.telemetry.diagnostics or {}).get('specdec2_mtp2')
    if arm=='staged':
     assert b is not None,(n,'missing stream accounting',asdict(chunk))
     if b['cycles']:
      assert chunk.telemetry.timing['mtp_visible_output_tokens']==b['mtp_output_tokens']
     blocks.append(b)
    else: assert b is None
   ids=next((list(c.generated_token_ids) for c in reversed(chunks) if c.generated_token_ids is not None),None)
   expected_stream_ids=expected[(cases[0]['id'],arm)][:n]
   text=''.join(c.text for c in chunks)
   expected_text=''.join(tokenizer.decode([token],skip_special_tokens=False) for token in expected_stream_ids)
   assert text==expected_text,(n,arm,'stream text mismatch',repr(text),repr(expected_text))
   assert chunks[-1].telemetry.decode_state.generated_tokens==n
   if ids is not None: assert ids==expected_stream_ids,(n,arm,ids)
   if arm=='staged':
    b=blocks[-1];assert b['mtp_output_tokens']+b['ar_output_tokens_in_cycles']==n,(n,b)
    assert all(a['ar_output_tokens_in_cycles']<=b['ar_output_tokens_in_cycles'] for a,b in zip(blocks,blocks[1:]))
   r['streams'].append({'id':cases[0]['id'],'arm':arm,'max_tokens':n,'ids':ids,'text':text,'text_matches_expected':True,'chunk_count':len(chunks),'chunks':[{'token_count':c.telemetry.decode_state.generated_tokens,'accounting':(c.telemetry.diagnostics or {}).get('specdec2_mtp2')} for c in chunks if c.telemetry is not None],'route':_latest_route_metadata(llm.live_loop_snapshot())});save()
   print('stream',n,arm,'text, counts and accounting exact',flush=True)
 r['passed']=True
finally:
 llm.close();save()
